notes.body:
Dulaglutide body model
Physiologically based pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model of dulaglutide in human.
Dulaglutide (59.7 kDa, a dimeric GLP-1 analogue fused to an IgG4 Fc fragment) is given subcutaneously: the dose enters a depot, from which the fraction Fsc_dul (the absolute bioavailability, 44 % after 1.5 mg) is absorbed into the venous plasma and the rest is degraded at the injection site (sc_deg_dul). An intravenous dose or infusion enters the venous plasma. Dulaglutide distributes from the plasma into the interstitial space of the tissues (ftissue_dul, Kp_dul) and is eliminated by protein catabolism (DULCAT, a plasma clearance which scales with the body weight). The intact protein is not excreted in the urine or the bile (FDA clinical pharmacology review BLA 125469). The amounts degraded at the injection site (Asc_deg_dul) and catabolized (Acat_dul) close the mass balance.
The fasting plasma glucose, the HbA1c and the body weight respond to the dulaglutide plasma concentration glp1.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

parameter.name: maximal effect of the GLP-1 agonist on the subcutaneous fat (fraction)

body.p: The fraction of the subcutaneous fat which is lost at a saturating concentration; the trials lose 1-3 kg of 10-20 kg of subcutaneous fat after 0.75 and 1.5 mg weekly.
The value of Emax_SAT_glp1 is the result of the fit PD_20261019_103700__c0378, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

The turnover rate of the hemoglobin fractions, which are amounts of the extent 1 mmole (conversion factor cf_units_per_mmole), so the unit is mmole/min for a rate in 1/min. The HbA1c relaxes with the rate k_hb_deg / (1 - hba1c0), a time constant of about 4.5 weeks; the HbA1c of the trials plateaus at 12-16 weeks (Nauck2014, Morioka2024, Pratley2018).
The value of k_hb_deg is the result of the fit PD_20261019_103700__c0378, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: Dulaglutide does not enter the red blood cells, its blood-to-plasma ratio is the plasma fraction of the blood, 1 - HCT.

Exchange flow between the plasma and the interstitial space of a tissue at the reference body weight BW_ref, it scales with the body weight. The intravenous data (FDAGBDR) fall from 35 ng/ml at 1 hr to 15 ng/ml at 24 hr before the terminal phase.

For females: LBM0 = 0.252×W + 0.473×H − 48.3
Where W is weight in kilograms and H is height in centimeters
Essential body fat (minimum needed for normal physiology) is higher in women (roughly 10–13%) than in men (roughly 2–5%)

Intraabdominal depots include visceral adipose tissues (VAT, omental and mesenteric), which are associated with di- gestive organs. VATs drain their blood into the portal vein and account for 6-20% of total body fat, with higher values in males than females [9-12].
For males: VAT0 = 0.2 * LBW0
For females: VAT0 = 0.1 * LBW0
BW0 = LBW0 + VAT0 + SAT0 = LBWO + FAT0
Lean body weight assumed constant.

Protein catabolism of dulaglutide (general proteolytic pathways, FDA clinical pharmacology review BLA 125469), from the venous blood.
